newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end down amid heavier trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end down amid heavier trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks drifted lower in busy sessions dominated by cross trades in Banco Ganadero shares, dealers said.

Bogota's IBB index ended down 0.23 percent at 877.27 on volume of 3.9 billion pesos, of which 2.6 billion pesos was in Banco Ganadero ordinary shares. Medellin's IBOMED general price index closed 0.29 percent down at 13,567.74 on a 1.78 billion peso trade, of which 955 million pesos was in Banco Ganadero preferential shares.

"The markets picked up a bit Tuesday but the trend is still towards profit-taking. We didn't hear of much demand from local or foreign fund demand for Banco Ganadero shares which leads us to believe most were cross trades between existing share holders," a Bogota broker said.
In the Bogota exchange, Banco Ganadero ordinary shares dropped 0.73 percent to 273 pesos. Preferential shares rose 1.5 percent to 202 pesos on volumeof 175 million pesos.
In Medellin, the bank's preferential shares rose one percent to 202 pesos.

A Medellin broker said there may be signs of foreign fund interest in Banco Ganadero preferential shares given expectations of good third quarter results but added demand may be being fueled by one large shareholder looking to restructure his share portfolio.

Other main movers on the Bogota exchange were Banco de Colombia, which fell 1.12 percent to 440 on a wave of profit-taking, brewing giant Bavaria, down 0.24 percent to 4,090 on volume of 173 million pesos, and supermarket chain Carulla, which dropped 0.21 percent to 5,937 on an 82.4 million peso trade.

In Medellin, Banco Industrial Colombiano remained unchanged at 3,500 pesos after cross trades amounting to 95 million pesos. Food manufacturer Industrias Alimenticias Noel closed unchanged at 2,800 pesos on a 95 million peso volume.
